name: did-host-http
description: DID-hosting node whose DID advertises an HTTP resolution endpoint (WebVHHosting) only — no DIDComm. Use this for a node whose only role is hosting DID logs for self-managed DIDs. If the node also needs to accept DIDComm (admin RPC, witness coordination, control-plane traffic), use 'did-host-http-didcomm' instead. Advertises `TrustTaskHTTPS` at `{URL}/api`: the control plane nests its whole API under `/api` off the origin root (did-hosting-control `routes/mod.rs`), so that is the Trust-Task base and `<base>/trust-tasks` is the endpoint (HTTPS binding 0.2 §6). `WebVHHosting` is NOT that endpoint — it says where DID documents are served, which is a different claim, and a consumer that posts Trust Tasks to it is posting to an endpoint that never agreed to accept them. A deployment that serves the control plane on a different origin from the hosting URL must edit this entry.
